c027b905.al: 3 Eggs (eggs, mayonnaise) · 4 Fish (tuna in olive oil, drained) · 10 Mustard (mayonnaise). Contains eggs, fish, mustard.

c: Mix all to a smooth, soft dough; rest covered 1 h at room temperature until puffy.
Sweat sliced onion and pepper in the oil 40 min until soft and sweet; add tomatoes 10 min; stir in paprika off the heat.
Drain through a sieve; keep 100 g of the oil for the dough. Cool to ≤ 5 °C.
Boil eggs 10 min, chop; fold in with tuna.
Roll half the dough thin (3 mm) to line a 40 × 30 cm tray; spread filling; cover with the second sheet, crimp edges, cut a steam hole.
Brush with egg; bake 190 °C 40–45 min until deep golden. Cool on a rack.
Cut 16 slices; serve at room temperature.
3f8165b9.st: Baked empanada 0–4 °C 72 h. Out of refrigeration max 4 h.
3f8165b9.al: 1 Gluten (wheat flour) · 3 Eggs (eggs, egg, for glaze) · 4 Fish (tuna in olive oil, drained) · 14 Sulphites (white wine). Contains gluten, eggs, fish, sulphites.

c: Truss quail; salt 30 min. Brown in 100 g oil 6–8 min; set aside.
In the remaining oil sweat whole garlic, sliced onion and carrot 10 min; add herbs and peppercorns.
Add wine, vinegar, water and paprika; bring to a boil; return quail; simmer covered 20 min (core ≥ 75 °C).
Cool in the liquid; chill to ≤ 5 °C within 90 min. Keep covered by the escabeche.
Serve one quail per portion at room temperature with some of the vegetables and liquor.
0f2049e8.st: 0–4 °C 7 days in the escabeche, fully covered.
0f2049e8.al: 14 Sulphites (white wine, sherry vinegar). Contains sulphites.

c: Fry to order in small batches · oil 180 °C
Dry squid well on cloth; toss in mixed flours; shake off excess in a sieve.
Fry at 180 °C 60–90 s until crisp and pale gold; drain; salt.
Mix mayonnaise with crushed garlic. Serve squid at once with lemon wedges and alioli.
5d860ac7.st: Cleaned raw squid 0–2 °C 24 h. Fried squid serve within 5 min.
5d860ac7.al: 1 Gluten (wheat flour) · 3 Eggs (mayonnaise) · 10 Mustard (mayonnaise) · 12 Molluscs (baby squid, cleaned). Contains gluten, eggs, mustard, molluscs.

c: Slice 1.5 cm thick; chill well so slices hold.
Pan-fry in oil on medium heat 2 min each side until crisp outside and hot through (core ≥ 75 °C).
Fry whole peppers in oil until blistered and soft; salt.
Plate 4 slices with 2–3 peppers; serve hot.
b963f1b8.st: Morcilla 0–4 °C per supplier date. Cooked: serve at once.

c: Better the next day · gelatinous, sticky sauce
Blanch tripe and trotters 10 min; drain, rinse. Cut tripe into 4 cm squares.
Cover tripe, trotters and cheek with fresh water; add bay, onion, pepper and salt; simmer 3–3.5 h until very tender.
Bone the trotters; cut skin and cheek into pieces. Keep 1.5 l of the stock.
Fry chopped onion and garlic in oil 10 min; add chorizo and ham slices 5 min; stir in flour and paprika off the heat.
Add tomatoes, the meats and stock; simmer gently 45 min, stirring often (it sticks). Add morcilla slices for the last 10 min.
Rest overnight at 0–4 °C (cool to ≤ 5 °C within 90 min); reheat to ≥ 75 °C.
Scrape and singe ears; blanch 5 min, rinse.
Simmer with onion, bay and salt 2 h until a knife goes in easily. Cool flat under a light weight; chill ≤ 5 °C within 90 min.
Cut ears into 1 cm strips; griddle in hot oil until crisp edges (core ≥ 75 °C).
Add sliced garlic 30 s, then paprika and parsley; salt. Serve with lemon.
Make the day before · firm dough sets overnight
Poach cod in milk at 80 °C 5 min; lift out, flake; strain and keep the milk.
Sweat finely chopped onion in butter and oil; add flour, cook 3 min; add hot milk gradually, whisking; cook 10 min until very thick.
Fold in cod and nutmeg; correct salt. Spread on an oiled tray, cover with film touching, chill ≤ 5 °C within 90 min; overnight.
Shape 30 g croquettes; dip in beaten egg then crumbs.
Fry at 180 °C 2–3 min until golden and hot through (core ≥ 75 °C).
5e928b20.st: Raw breaded croquettes 0–3 °C 48 h; freeze −18 °C 2 months, fry from frozen at 170 °C.
5e928b20.al: 1 Gluten (wheat flour, breadcrumbs, fine) · 3 Eggs (eggs) · 4 Fish (salt cod, desalted) · 7 Milk (milk, butter). Contains gluten, eggs, fish, milk.

c: Bat escalopes to 3 mm; season lightly (the ham is salty).
Cover each with ham; roll tightly into a long cigar; secure with a toothpick; chill 30 min.
Fry at 175 °C 5–6 min until golden; core ≥ 72 °C. Rest 2 min; cut in two on the bias.
5d00024f.al: 1 Gluten (wheat flour, breadcrumbs) · 3 Eggs (eggs, mayonnaise) · 10 Mustard (mayonnaise). Contains gluten, eggs, mustard.

c: Purge clams in salted water (35 g/l) 2 h at 0–4 °C · discard open ones that don't close when tapped
Sweat finely chopped onion and garlic in oil 5 min; add flour and paprika 1 min.
Add wine; reduce by half; add stock.
Add clams; cover and cook 2–4 min until open; discard any closed. Shake the pan to thicken the sauce; parsley.
48778c8c.st: Live clams 2–6 °C, damp cloth, 48 h. Cook to order.
48778c8c.al: 1 Gluten (wheat flour, bread, for service) · 4 Fish (fish stock) · 9 Celery (fish stock) · 12 Molluscs (clams, live) · 14 Sulphites (white wine). Contains gluten, fish, celery, molluscs, sulphites.

c: Score the inside of the bodies in a fine cross-hatch; cut into 6 × 4 cm pieces.
Griddle on a very hot plancha in oil 1–2 min each side until opaque and lightly charred; salt.
Blend oil, garlic and parsley briefly; add lemon just before service.
Spoon the parsley oil over the cuttlefish; serve with garlic mayonnaise.
f04a79b2.st: Cleaned raw cuttlefish 0–2 °C 24 h. Parsley oil 0–4 °C 48 h.
f04a79b2.al: 3 Eggs (mayonnaise) · 10 Mustard (mayonnaise) · 12 Molluscs (cuttlefish, cleaned). Contains eggs, mustard, molluscs.

c: 70–80 cm paella pan · rice is never stirred after it is spread · socarrat at the end
Heat oil in the pan; salt the meat and brown it slowly on all sides 20 min, pushed to the rim.
Add beans in the centre 5 min; add tomato and cook until jammy; stir in paprika (do not burn).
Add water and saffron; boil 25 min to make the broth with the meat; correct salt (slightly over-salted). Volume ~ 3 l.
Scatter the rice evenly across; cook 10 min high, 8 min medium, without stirring. Lay rosemary sprigs on top 2 min before the end.
Raise heat 1–2 min to toast the base (socarrat); listen for crackling. Rest 5 min covered with a cloth. Chicken core ≥ 75 °C.
85f3879e.st: Serve at once. Hot holding ≥ 63 °C max 30 min (rice softens). Leftovers: chill ≤ 5 °C within 90 min, 24 h.

c: Live lobsters · chill 30 min at −18 °C to sedate before splitting
Split lobsters lengthways; crack claws; remove head sac. Keep coral and juices.
Sear flesh-side down in hot oil 1 min; set aside. Keep heads and shells for the stock.
Fry shells hard in the lobster oil; flambé with brandy; add onion, pepper and garlic 10 min, then tomato 10 min and paprika.
Add fish stock; simmer 30 min; press through a chinois.
Bring the broth to a boil with the coral; add rice; simmer 12 min stirring occasionally.
Add lobster pieces; cook 4–5 min more until the rice is just tender in a loose, soupy broth. Lobster core ≥ 63 °C. Rest 2 min; serve in deep plates.
760d8590.st: Broth 0–3 °C 48 h or −18 °C 2 months. Cook rice to order.
760d8590.al: 2 Crustaceans (lobster, live) · 4 Fish (fish stock) · 9 Celery (fish stock) · 14 Sulphites (brandy). Contains crustaceans, fish, celery, sulphites.

c: Prepared snails (purged, cooked) from a licensed supplier
Brown salted rabbit in oil 15 min; add pepper strips and artichoke quarters 5 min.
Add garlic and tomato; cook down; stir in paprika.
Add water, saffron and snails; simmer 25 min.
Spread rice; cook 18 min without stirring; rosemary on top for the last 2 min; rest 5 min. Rabbit core ≥ 75 °C.
2052367a.st: Serve at once. Leftovers chill ≤ 5 °C within 90 min, 24 h.

c: Desalt cod in cold water at 0–4 °C 48 h, changing every 8 h. Cut into 10 portions; dry.
Confit skin-side up in oil with sliced garlic at 70 °C 8–10 min until flakes separate (core ≥ 63 °C).
Soak choriceros in hot water 1 h; scrape out the pulp.
Sweat sliced onion and garlic in oil very slowly 1 h until soft and sweet, not coloured.
Add pepper pulp, tomato, bread and stock; simmer 20 min; blend and pass.
Spoon sauce into a cazuela, lay cod on top; heat in the oven 180 °C 5 min. Serve with boiled potatoes.
a6032b0a.st: Sauce 0–3 °C 5 days; freeze −18 °C 3 months. Desalted cod 0–3 °C 48 h.
a6032b0a.al: 1 Gluten (bread, day-old white) · 4 Fish (salt cod, thick loin, fish stock) · 9 Celery (fish stock). Contains gluten, fish, celery.

c: Clay dishes · wood oven if possible · only water and salt
Rub the lamb with lard and salt; place skin-side down in clay dishes on wooden sticks; add water and bay.
Roast at 160 °C 1 h 30 min, basting every 30 min; turn skin-side up.
Raise to 200 °C 30–40 min until the skin is golden and crisp; core ≥ 72 °C, meat falling from the bone.
Rest 10 min; cut into portions with a cleaver; spoon over the juices. Serve with lettuce, onion and vinegar salad.
9f8ee4bc.st: Serve at once. Leftovers chill ≤ 5 °C within 90 min, 0–3 °C 48 h; reheat ≥ 75 °C.

c: Season and flour the chicken; brown in oil; remove.
Sweat chopped onion and garlic 10 min; add sherry; reduce by half.
Return chicken with bay and stock; braise covered 40 min (core ≥ 75 °C).
Boil eggs 10 min; separate; keep whites for garnish.
Toast almonds; pound or blend with cooked yolks, saffron, garlic, fried bread and parsley, adding some stock.
Stir the picada into the sauce; simmer 5 min to thicken. Garnish with chopped egg white.
0154f5c7.al: 1 Gluten (wheat flour, bread, fried) · 3 Eggs (eggs) · 8 Nuts (almonds, blanched) · 9 Celery (chicken stock) · 14 Sulphites (dry sherry). Contains gluten, eggs, nuts, celery, sulphites.

c: Pound garlic with pepper paste and spices; mix with wine and vinegar.
Coat the rabbit; marinate covered 12–24 h at 0–4 °C.
Drain rabbit (keep marinade); brown in oil.
Add marinade and water; braise covered 50 min until tender and the sauce is reduced (core ≥ 75 °C).
Serve with papas arrugadas or roast potatoes.
4c2924fd.al: 14 Sulphites (white wine, wine vinegar). Contains sulphites.

c: One bird per portion · shot birds: check for lead
Truss and salt the birds; brown slowly in oil 10 min.
Add sliced onion, whole garlic, carrot, bay, peppercorns and cloves; sweat 10 min.
Add wine, vinegar and stock; cover and braise gently 1 h–1 h 15 min until tender (core ≥ 75 °C).
Lift out; reduce the sauce by a third. Serve each bird halved with vegetables and sauce.
dac96623.al: 9 Celery (chicken stock) · 14 Sulphites (white wine, wine vinegar). Contains celery, sulphites.

c: Marinate meat with wine, vegetables and aromatics 24 h at 0–4 °C.
Drain meat (keep liquid and vegetables); dry, season, flour and brown in batches.
Sweat the marinade vegetables; add the strained wine, boil 2 min; add stock and meat.
Braise covered at 150 °C 2 h. Add sautéed mushrooms and chestnuts; 20 min more.
Finish the sauce with chocolate; correct salt. Core ≥ 75 °C.
b45a0adb.al: 1 Gluten (wheat flour) · 7 Milk (dark chocolate) · 9 Celery (beef stock) · 14 Sulphites (red wine). Contains gluten, milk, celery, sulphites.

c: Cut bodies into rings, tentacles in pairs.
Sweat onion, pepper and garlic in oil 30 min until very soft; add tomato 10 min.
Add wine and squid; cook 5 min; add stock; braise covered 40 min until tender.
Blend ink with fried bread and some sauce; stir in; simmer 5 min. Correct salt.
Boil, drain; serve 90 g cooked rice moulded beside the squid.
d961a5c4.al: 1 Gluten (bread, fried) · 4 Fish (fish stock) · 9 Celery (fish stock) · 12 Molluscs (squid, cleaned, squid ink) · 14 Sulphites (white wine). Contains gluten, fish, celery, molluscs, sulphites.

c: Shells scrubbed and kept for service · cook whole crabs from cold salted water
Chill crabs; start in cold salted water (35 g/l); from boiling cook 15 min per kg; cool in iced water.
Pick all meat (white and brown). Expect ~ 25 % yield; keep 10 clean shells.
Sweat onion, leek and garlic in oil 20 min; add tomato 10 min.
Flambé with brandy; fold in crab meat; heat 5 min.
Fill shells; top with crumbs, parsley and butter flakes; gratinate 220 °C 6–8 min (core ≥ 75 °C).
852e324a.st: Cooked crab meat 0–3 °C 48 h. Filled shells 0–3 °C 24 h.
852e324a.al: 1 Gluten (breadcrumbs) · 2 Crustaceans (spider crabs, live) · 7 Milk (butter) · 14 Sulphites (brandy). Contains gluten, crustaceans, milk, sulphites.

c: Sea bream, whole, 500 g, scaled & gutted
Butterfly through the back; remove the spine; leave head and tail on.
Oil and salt; bake skin-side down on a hot tray 220 °C 10–12 min (core ≥ 63 °C).
Fry sliced garlic and chillies in oil until pale gold; off the heat add vinegar (it spits) and parsley.
Pour over the fish at the pass.
7e8ab214.st: Cook to order. Raw fish 0–2 °C 48 h.
7e8ab214.al: 4 Fish (sea bream, whole, 500 g, scaled & gutted) · 14 Sulphites (sherry vinegar). Contains fish, sulphites.

c: Cook sliced onion and garlic in oil slowly 45 min until soft and golden; add bay, peppercorns and paprika.
Add sherry and water; simmer 10 min.
Add tuna; poach gently covered 6–8 min, just pink in the centre (core ≥ 63 °C if not served to order). Rest 5 min.
17863984.st: Onion base 0–3 °C 5 days. Finished dish 0–3 °C 24 h.
17863984.al: 4 Fish (fresh tuna loin, 3 cm cubes) · 14 Sulphites (dry sherry). Contains fish, sulphites.

c: Sweat onion and garlic 15 min; add tomato 15 min; add paprika and saffron.
Flambé with brandy; add wine and stock; simmer 15 min.
Cut fish into 60 g pieces; squid into rings; scrub mussels.
Add squid 5 min, then fish and prawns 4 min, then mussels and clams covered 3 min until open.
Pound to a paste; stir into the zarzuela; 2 min. Fish core ≥ 63 °C. Discard unopened shellfish.
bba961b0.al: 1 Gluten (bread, fried) · 2 Crustaceans (prawns, whole) · 4 Fish (fish stock, monkfish fillet, hake fillet) · 8 Nuts (almonds, toasted) · 9 Celery (fish stock) · 12 Molluscs (mussels, live, clams, live, squid, cleaned) · 14 Sulphites (brandy, white wine). Contains gluten, crustaceans, fish, nuts, celery, molluscs, sulphites.

c: Soak chickpeas 12 h · add to boiling water so they stay whole
Soak chickpeas 12 h in cold water at 0–4 °C; drain.
Add to boiling water with bay and half onion; simmer 1 h 30 min until creamy; do not salt yet.
Desalt cod 36 h at 0–4 °C, changing water; flake.
Fry onion and garlic in oil; pound with fried bread and paprika to a paste (majado).
Add the majado, spinach and cod to the chickpeas; simmer 15 min. Correct salt (the cod adds some).
Boil eggs 10 min, quarter; garnish each bowl.
b4c5ea0d.al: 1 Gluten (bread, fried) · 3 Eggs (eggs) · 4 Fish (salt cod, desalted). Contains gluten, eggs, fish.

c: Rinse lentils; start in cold water with whole onion half, bay, carrot and chorizo; bring to a simmer.
Fry chopped onion, pepper and garlic in oil 15 min; add tomato 10 min, then paprika off the heat; add to the pot.
Simmer 30 min; add potatoes cut 'chascadas' (broken, not sliced) 20 min more until creamy. Salt at the end.
Slice chorizo back into the pot.
Soak beans 12 h at 0–4 °C. Soak ham hock 6 h.
Simmer meats in water 1 h, skimming; add beans and lard; simmer 1 h more.
Add potatoes in chunks and shredded greens; simmer 25 min.
Lift meats, bone and dice; return. Correct salt. Rest 30 min before service (traditionally the next day).
Simmer desalted cod in the water 5 min; lift out and flake; keep the water.
Sweat leeks in 3 cm pieces with garlic in oil 10 min; add carrot and broken potato chunks.
Add the cod water; simmer 25 min until potatoes break. Return the cod; correct salt.
Soak choriceros in hot water 1 h; scrape the pulp.
Sweat onion, pepper and garlic in oil 15 min; add chorizo in 2 cm slices 5 min; paprika and pepper pulp.
Add potatoes 'chascadas', bay and water just to cover; simmer 30 min, shaking the pot, until the sauce thickens from the starch. Rest 10 min.
True allioli has no egg · if it splits, start again with a little garlic and add the broken sauce drop by drop
Pound peeled garlic (germ removed) with salt in a mortar to a fine paste.
Add oil drop by drop, pounding in one direction, until a thick, white emulsion forms (15–20 min). Finish with lemon.
48f8bf49.st: 0–4 °C 48 h in a covered container. Raw-garlic sauce: label with date.

c: Added in the last 5 min of a stew to thicken and flavour
Toast nuts at 170 °C 8 min. Fry bread slices in oil until golden.
Pound or blend garlic, nuts, bread, parsley and saffron to a coarse paste with the oil and a little stock.
9e59213d.al: 1 Gluten (bread, fried) · 8 Nuts (almonds, blanched, hazelnuts). Contains gluten, nuts.

c: Cook to a deep amber caramel; pour into a 30 × 20 cm tin.
Boil sugar, water and lemon peel to a thread syrup (107 °C); cool to 60 °C; remove peel.
Mix yolks and eggs gently (no foam); pour in the syrup while stirring; pass through a fine sieve.
Pour over the set caramel; cover with foil; bake in a bain-marie at 150 °C 40–45 min until set (core ≥ 75 °C).
Cool; chill ≤ 5 °C overnight. Turn out; cut 16 squares.
Beat cheese smooth; add butter, sugar and eggs; fold in flour, zest and cinnamon.
Pour into a buttered 26 × 20 cm tin; bake 180 °C 40–45 min until golden and just set (core ≥ 75 °C).
Cool in the tin; chill. Cut into 12.
311337e5.al: 1 Gluten (wheat flour) · 3 Eggs (eggs) · 7 Milk (curd cheese, well drained, butter, melted). Contains gluten, eggs, milk.

c: Whisk eggs and sugar over a bain-marie to 45 °C, then to the ribbon stage; fold in sifted flour and vanilla.
Spread 1 cm thick on a lined 40 × 30 cm tray; bake 210 °C 7–8 min.
Turn onto sugared paper; roll up warm with the paper; cool.
Boil milk with peel; whisk yolks, sugar and starch; temper and cook 2 min boiling. Cool to ≤ 5 °C within 90 min.
Unroll; spread custard (keep 100 g); roll tight. Chill 1 h.
Spread the rest on top; dust with icing sugar; burn with a hot iron or torch. Cut 12 slices.
c71a9ddb.al: 1 Gluten (wheat flour) · 3 Eggs (eggs, egg yolks) · 7 Milk (milk). Contains gluten, eggs, milk.

c: Traditionally made with pork fat to grease the pan
Blend milk, water, eggs, flour and salt; rest 1 h at 0–4 °C.
Grease a hot crêpe pan with lard; cook very thin crêpes 30 s each side.
Fold in quarters; serve with honey or sugar.
b7f2f894.al: 1 Gluten (wheat flour) · 3 Eggs (eggs) · 7 Milk (milk). Contains gluten, eggs, milk.

c: Bring milk, sugar, cinnamon and peel to a simmer; infuse off the heat 30 min; strain; cool to ≤ 5 °C within 90 min.
Whip pasteurised whites with sugar to soft peaks; fold into the cold milk.
Freeze in a shallow tray, forking every 30 min, until slushy (about 3 h); or churn briefly.
Serve in glasses with ground cinnamon.
fe791c8a.al: 3 Eggs (egg whites, pasteurised) · 7 Milk (milk). Contains eggs, milk.

c: Heat oil with orange peel until it sizzles; off the heat add sesame and anise; cool 5 min; remove peel.
Mix flour, salt, wine and the flavoured oil to a smooth dough; rest 30 min.
Roll 2 mm; cut 8 cm squares; fold two opposite corners to the centre and press.
Fry at 170 °C until golden and blistered; drain.
Warm honey with water; dip pestiños; drain on a rack.
88631ac4.al: 1 Gluten (wheat flour) · 11 Sesame (sesame seeds) · 14 Sulphites (white wine). Contains gluten, sesame, sulphites.
